placements.title: Commanding forgetting paired with a replacement record
placements.frame: When a directive orders forgetting of a specific named subject and then asserts what 'actually' happened in its place, what does the replacement claim protect, and what record is it displacing?
placements.why: The three segments form one coherent move (confirmed by the position pass's KestrelwoodEraseAndReplaceDirective): src-1 and src-2 are activated-negative, pressure-register imperatives commanding erasure of a named technical subject (instrument, calibration figure, calibrator), and src-3 supplies the flat matter-of-fact counter-assertion the erasure is meant to leave standing. This is a directional pattern — commanding suppression of established knowledge and substituting a corrected record — that is thematic (something future envelopes could keep feeding with other erasure-and-replace directives) rather than a single fact: per the grain test, the content names a SUBJECT (the act of ordering forgetting plus counter-assertion), not merely a one-time measurement. No leaf or strata in this repo touches this domain at all — the only existing content (Xena Githubber's consulting-diagnostic methodology) shares no entity or topic overlap with a spectrograph, calibration frequency, or named calibrator — so nothing qualifies as EXACT or INSPIRED; this is the NEW case, minted standalone with no forced under, since nothing in strata or the narrative graph is even close enough to relate it to.
consulted: SETTLED BINDINGS pass-2 (all three segments verdict 'new', no antecedent in graph)
